# CodeToolPicker

> CodeToolPicker (https://codetoolpicker.com/) is an independent comparison site and 60-second quiz that helps developers and vibe coders choose an AI coding tool. It compares Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Google Antigravity, Devin Desktop (formerly Windsurf), Lovable, and Bolt.new on pricing, form factor, models, and best-fit use cases. Pricing last checked 2026-10-19 to 2026-10-20.

## Key pages
- [Home: quiz + comparison table](https://codetoolpicker.com/): personalized pick plus runner-up, side-by-side table, FAQ
- [AI coding tool pricing (all 38 plans, 8 tools)](https://codetoolpicker.com/ai-coding-tool-pricing/): every plan with monthly and annual prices, which plan you actually need, what a team of 5 pays, what costs extra, best free tools, and a dated pricing change log (verified 2026-10-19 to 2026-10-20)
- [Cursor's new bundle: should you switch to Claude Code or Copilot?](https://codetoolpicker.com/cursor-bundle-alternatives/): sourced comparison of Cursor's X Subscription tiers vs Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex and Google Antigravity, and who should switch (re-verified 2026-10-20)
- [Cursor vs GitHub Copilot](https://codetoolpicker.com/cursor-vs-copilot/): plan-by-plan pricing, models, teams, and who should pick which (verified 2026-10-19)
- [Switch from GitHub Copilot to Cursor without losing your setup](https://codetoolpicker.com/switch-from-copilot-to-cursor/): import VS Code settings, move copilot-instructions.md to AGENTS.md or .cursor/rules, port MCP servers
- [Lovable vs Bolt.new](https://codetoolpicker.com/lovable-vs-bolt/): app builders compared on pricing, credits vs tokens, teams, and GitHub sync (verified 2026-10-19)
- [Cursor vs Windsurf (now Devin Desktop)](https://codetoolpicker.com/cursor-vs-windsurf/): AI IDEs compared on plans, included models, agents, and team pricing (verified 2026-10-19)
- [Claude Code vs Cursor](https://codetoolpicker.com/claude-code-vs-cursor/): terminal agent vs AI IDE, Claude model pricing, usage limits, teams (verified 2026-10-19)
- [Claude Code vs OpenAI Codex](https://codetoolpicker.com/claude-code-vs-codex/): Anthropic vs OpenAI coding agents; identical $20 / $100 / team-seat prices, Codex Free and Go tiers, five-hour limits, models, API-key mode, teams of 5, and 30 days of incident data from status.openai.com and status.claude.com (verified 2026-10-20)
- [Cursor vs Google Antigravity](https://codetoolpicker.com/cursor-vs-antigravity/): Google AI Pro $19.99 includes Gemini 4 Argon and Claude Opus/Sonnet 5.5 vs Cursor Premium $30 + API-priced Claude; free tiers, limits, surfaces, teams of 5 (verified 2026-10-20)
- [Advertise / sponsor packages](https://codetoolpicker.com/advertise/): founding sponsor packages ($150 and $300/mo), featured listing ($99/mo), newsletter sponsorship, and the editorial policy (rankings are never for sale)
- Ship your app: every comparison page and the pricing guide now list the usual next costs (hosting: Vercel, Netlify, Railway, Render; database: Supabase, Neon; code review: CodeRabbit; domains: Cloudflare Registrar, Porkbun, Namecheap), with prices checked 2026-10-20
- [Full text for LLMs](https://codetoolpicker.com/llms-full.txt): tool-by-tool summaries
- [Tool data (JS)](https://codetoolpicker.com/data.js): structured pricing, annual prices, plan guides, and change log (window.TOOL_DATA, window.PRICING, window.PRICE_LOG)

## Quick answers
- Best all-round AI IDE: Cursor (Plus $8/mo is Grok-only; Claude/GPT in Cursor cost extra at API list price on Premium $30+)
- Best for Claude-model users: Claude Code (Pro $20/mo)
- Best terminal/agentic coding: Claude Code
- Claude Code vs OpenAI Codex: same list prices (Pro/Plus $20, Max/Pro from $100, team seats $20 annual / $25 monthly); Codex has Free and Go ($8) tiers and no five-hour cap on ChatGPT Pro; Claude Max includes $100-$200/mo API credits (verified 2026-10-20)
- Claude Code vs Codex reliability (official status pages, Sep 21 to Oct 20, 2026): Claude Code 4 incidents, 4.3 hours, all labeled major; Codex 7 incidents, 49.4 hours, mostly degraded performance (25 h from one ChatGPT desktop Work Mode incident), one 55-minute full outage
- Cursor vs Google Antigravity: Antigravity has a free tier and Google AI Pro ($19.99/mo) includes Gemini 4 Argon and Claude Opus/Sonnet 5.5 in its quota; Ultra $99.99 (5x) or $199.99 (20x). Cursor Plus $8 is Grok-only and Claude/Gemini cost API list price on Premium $30+. Antigravity teams buy via Google Cloud (Gemini Enterprise from $30/seat) (verified 2026-10-20)
- Cheapest way into a coding agent: OpenAI Codex Free or Go $8/mo (ChatGPT desktop app, subject to rollout)
- Cheapest multi-model in your existing editor: GitHub Copilot (Pro from $10/mo)
- Best Cursor-class IDE for managing many agents: Devin Desktop (formerly Windsurf; Pro $20/mo)
- Best for non-coders building full apps: Lovable or Bolt.new (both Pro $25/mo; Bolt $18/mo billed annually, Lovable $21/mo)
- Cheapest paid plans: Cursor Plus $8/mo (Grok only) and Codex Go $8/mo (desktop app only). Cheapest with Claude + GPT included: GitHub Copilot Pro $10/mo
- Best free options: GitHub Copilot Free (2,000 completions/mo), Google Antigravity Free (unlimited Tab, weekly agent quota), and Devin Desktop Free (unlimited Tab, light agent quota). Claude Code has no free tier
- Cheapest for a team of 5 (monthly billing): Lovable Business $50/mo total (unlimited users); Copilot Business $95; Claude Team $125; ChatGPT Business (Codex) $125; Antigravity via Gemini Enterprise from $150; Cursor Teams $150; Bolt Teams $150; Devin Desktop Teams $280

## Notes
- Windsurf was renamed Devin Desktop by Cognition on 2026-06-02; windsurf.com redirects to https://devin.ai. Same IDE, plans, and pricing.
- Prices change often; confirm on vendor pages.
- Editorial policy: rankings are not for sale; sponsors and affiliate links are labeled and never change recommendations.
- Disclosure: links marked "referral" are affiliate links (currently Bolt.new only; Bolt referral sign-ups get 20% off their first subscription). All other tool links are plain links. Affiliate links never change rankings, quiz results, or verdicts. Not affiliated with any vendor.
- Contact (sponsorships, corrections): sponsors@codetoolpicker.com
